hints.content:
An $\blueE{\text{exponent}}$ tells us how many factors of a $\maroonD{\text{base}}$ we should multiply to find the value of an expression.

Exponential form has a base and an exponent, like this: $\maroonD{\text{base}}^\blueE{\text{exponent}}$

For example,

$\maroonD{3} \times \maroonD{3} = \boxed{\maroonD{3}^\blueE{2}}$

The base is the number we are multiplying. So, the base is $9$.

$9\times9\times9\times9\times9\times9\times9$ has $7$ factors of the base $9$. So, the exponent is $7$.
